protocol.source_scope: Four metric pairs plus stage candidate plus six mature C2 numerical baselines; common total120cap
protocol.selection: minimum original paid Phi; all native extra physical audits retained and charged
protocol.secondary: min original R among legal original-CN99 paid candidates, fallback primary
protocol.corrector: Original numerical L-BFGS-B; total absoluteCPU120 after<=72proposal; unused proposal reallocated for all arms
protocol.cadence: first complete material update after each absolute two-process-CPU-second bucket; preserve native initial/stage/final audits. Corrector/direct every paid objective evaluation.
protocol.truth_policy: NONE online; freeze all predictions before independent offline scoring
protocol.parameter_policy: Frozen complete cohort; no outcome-based exclusions, tuning, or budget extensions
protocol.material_M0_beta: b0=1 in every stage; not historical Dual beta_material
protocol.material_M1_beta: b1=1,.2,.2,.2 from the original A+ schedule
protocol.lane_policy: All arms per case sequential on the same pinned P core; complete every case/arm despite other failures
protocol.direct_control: Frozen C2 direct physical L-BFGS-B from same m_init, entire120CPU, maxiter6000/maxfun24000; no auxiliary72/48split

basis_contract.internal: first19 G right singular vectors; direct original prepare_full when its .1 strong rank equals19; otherwise fail, never lower rank
basis_contract.observation: first19 right singular vectors of unscaled S; same right subspace as common scalar W S, no inverse-sigma weighting; actual CN/source contract unchanged
basis_contract.anchor_observation: first19 right singular vectors of unscaled O0=S(I-D_m0 G)^-1; same common-scalar whitened subspace; public m0=.1 cached initialLU only, nr adjoint RHS, zero additionalLU, no full inverse; NOT material Jacobian
basis_contract.galerkin: K=P G P; B=U(U* G U)
basis_contract.rank_policy: fixed19; insufficient requested basis produces a retained failure, never rank adjustment

manifest_snapshot.selector: Same original paid minPhi/secondary/prefix rules; no GT use or parameter changes
manifest_snapshot.budget: Original C2 same-process absolute120 and proposal<=72 with remaining original corrector; imports/setup/snapshots and failures paid
manifest_snapshot.physics: Original full scalar TM Maxwell model; no substitution of S or O0 for physical G; 576 real material DOF
manifest_snapshot.fixed_expansion_policy: Exactly three bases x two projection modes, no further expansion/sweep after freeze
